subject: POC technical runbook & benchmark window — scheduling
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenbeta.ai>, Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@greenbeta.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 17:12:00 -0400
Subject: POC technical runbook & proposed benchmark window

Hi Alyssa / Sam —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC week. To make the load/benchmark portion useful for both teams I put together a short runbook (attached) and a couple of proposed windows. High-level asks before we lock a slot: 

- Confirm throughput target (tokens/sec or concurrent requests) you want us to validate.
- Confirm any maintenance/blackout windows on your side (we see a note about an infra freeze in early Oct).
- Provide a list of internal attendees for the run (SRE, App owner, and one dev ideally).

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 2026-10-06 14:00–16:30 PT — Full dry-run + 60m load blast + 30m analysis
- Thu 2026-10-07 09:00–11:30 PT — Fallback (if midweek holidays conflict)

Attachments: poc-runbook-v1.pdf (high-level steps + pre-checklist). Connor will follow up with the load harness config and a short checklist for warming KV caches.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenbeta.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@greenbeta.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 20:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC technical runbook & proposed benchmark window

Vivek —

Thanks for the runbook, this looks good on our side. A few notes: 

- Target: our initial goal is ~12k tokens/sec sustained (approx 3k concurrent short requests) with p95 latency under 250ms for single-turn text gen. We can provide a small sample of production request traces if helpful.
- Maintenance: we have a planned infra freeze on 2026-10-07 from 00:00–06:00 PT, so Thu morning might be risky.
- Attendees: Myself (product), Sam (SRE lead), and David Reynolds (platform eng) — David is cc'd on a separate thread and will join the session.

If Wed 10/06 14:00 PT works, please send an invite. Also: we prefer a brief dry-run 30–45m the business day before if possible (just to validate credentials, network egress rules, and that the harness runs at all).

Attaching: greenbeta-sre-list.pdf (contact + bastion details masked).

Best,
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Product, GreenBeta AI
alyssa@greenbeta.ai

[Attachment: greenbeta-sre-list.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenbeta.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC technical runbook & proposed benchmark window

Alyssa —

Thanks — we'll plan for Wed 10/06 14:00 PT as primary and schedule a 30–45m dry-run Tue 10/05 10:00 PT by default unless you ask otherwise.

I'll attach a minimal load-test-config.yaml that mirrors the harness we'll run (burst profile, ramp, and KV warmup steps). Key callouts here: 
- Warmup: 10 minutes of low-rate traffic with full KV cache load (we'll send warmup traces you can scrub).
- Ramp: linear 0 -> target over 5 minutes, then sustained for the agreed window; we'll surface token-level metrics and per-shard latency.
- Fallback: if tail latencies spike, we'll cut to a smaller model variant and record diff.

Please confirm David or another platform contact can open: 443/TCP to our public test endpoints and allow the IP range listed in the runbook.

[Attachment: load-test-config.yaml (text/yaml)]

— Connor
Connor O'Brien
Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@greenbeta.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenbeta.ai>, David Reynolds <david.reynolds@greenbeta.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC technical runbook & proposed benchmark window

Connor / Vivek —

Appreciate the clarity. Quick update from infra: we have a tenant-level storage maintenance starting 10/07 00:00 PT which may affect background GC and could confound metrics on Thu. Can you do Wed 10/06 but shift the start to 16:00 PT so we finish closer to evening on our side (our team is distributed). 

Also: for the latency SLOs — are you planning to measure p50/p95/p99 at the token level or at request-completion? For our work, request-completion is most meaningful (we're batching in front).

If you can share the harness repo link and the specific dashboards you'll push into our account ahead of time we'll make sure dashboards are pinned and we have SRE watching.

— Sam
Sam Taylor
SRE Lead, GreenBeta AI
sam.taylor@greenbeta.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@greenbeta.ai>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenbeta.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC technical runbook & proposed benchmark window

Sam / Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads-up. Wed 10/06 16:00 PT works for us; we've updated the internal run plan to: 

- 16:00–16:20 PT: credentials + network checks + quick dry run (smoke)
- 16:20–17:20 PT: primary load run (ramp + sustained) — target 12k tokens/sec
- 17:20–17:50 PT: quick analysis & rollback steps (model fallback if needed)

Latency measurement: we will report both per-token and end-to-end request latencies (p50/p95/p99) but for your dashboard we'll populate request-completion metrics as primary. We'll also push a small Grafana panel set into the shared dashboard link before Tue EOD.

I've attached an updated runbook excerpt with the KV warmup sequence, expected VM/worker counts for the target, and a short checklist for your infra team to confirm IP egress. Calendar invite attached: 20261006 POC - Bench Run (Redwood x GreenBeta).ics

[Attachment: poc-runbook-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: calendar-invite-20261006.ics (text/calendar)]

If anything changes on your side (David / infra), flag it here and we'll move the fallback to 10/08 morning.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Manager, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@greenbeta.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@greenbeta.ai>, David Reynolds <david.reynolds@greenbeta.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 11:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC technical runbook & benchmark window

All set — Wed 2026-10-06 16:00 PT confirmed. Attendees: Alyssa (product), Sam (SRE), David (platform), plus two engineers (TBD). We'll stand up a Slack channel briefly during the run for live notes.

Thanks for the quick turn. See you Wednesday — will join the dry-run Tue 10/05 10:00 PT to validate access.

Best,
Alyssa
